name: DropdownMenu
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes UI (e.g. `DropdownMenu(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

DropdownMenuCheckboxItem.description: A toggleable item with a check. Keeps the menu open and emits `checked-change` { item, checked }.

DropdownMenuContent.description: The menu's popup, placed against the trigger: `side:` (:bottom, :top, :inline_end, :inline_start), `align:` (:start, :center, :end), `side_offset:` and `align_offset:`.

DropdownMenuGroup.description: A labelled section of a menu - give it a DropdownMenuGroupLabel.

DropdownMenuGroupLabel.description: The heading of a DropdownMenuGroup or DropdownMenuRadioGroup.

DropdownMenuItem.description: One action. Selecting it (click, Enter, Space) emits `select` and closes the menu; `close_on_click: false` keeps it open. Tag a leading icon `data: { icon: "start" }` and push a trailing Kbd or badge to the edge with `class: "ms-auto"`. `label:` is what typeahead matches.

DropdownMenuLinkItem.description: An item that is a link (<a>) - for navigation from the menu.

DropdownMenuRadioGroup.description: Mutually exclusive DropdownMenuRadioItems. Choosing one emits `value-change` { group, value }.

DropdownMenuRadioItem.description: One option of a DropdownMenuRadioGroup; checked when the group's value matches. Keeps the menu open.

DropdownMenuSeparator.description: A thin divider between items or groups.

DropdownMenuSub.description: A nested submenu: DropdownMenuSubTrigger plus DropdownMenuSubContent.

DropdownMenuSubContent.description: A submenu's popup - beside its trigger (inline-end, flipping at the edge).

DropdownMenuSubTrigger.description: The item that opens a submenu, with a trailing chevron - on hover, click or the arrow toward it.

DropdownMenuTrigger.description: The button that toggles the menu. A block taking an argument receives its attributes for your own element (Appica's `render` prop): `DropdownMenuTrigger { |t| Button(**t) { "Open" } }`.

examples.name: Usage
Account menu
examples.notes:
A header of plain markup, grouped items with count badges, a Settings submenu, a dark-mode
Switch that keeps the menu open, and sign out.

examples.name: Icons, shortcuts & animated chevron
examples.notes: A Kbd pushed to the edge with `ms-auto`; the trigger's chevron flips while open.
examples.code:
phlex do
  DropdownMenu do
    DropdownMenuTrigger do |trigger|
      Button(**trigger, variant: :outline, class: "group/trigger") do
        plain "Edit"
        Icon(:chevron_down, data: { icon: "end" }, class: "group-data-popup-open/trigger:rotate-180 motion-safe:transition-transform motion-safe:duration-200")
      end
    end
    DropdownMenuContent do
      { copy: [ "Copy", "⌘C" ], scissors: [ "Cut", "⌘X" ], clipboard: [ "Paste", "⌘V" ] }.each do |icon, (label, keys)|
        DropdownMenuItem { Icon(icon, data: { icon: "start" }); plain label; Kbd(size: :sm, class: "ms-auto") { keys } }
      end
      DropdownMenuSeparator()
      DropdownMenuItem(class: "text-error-emphasis") { Icon(:trash, data: { icon: "start" }); plain "Delete"; Kbd(size: :sm, class: "ms-auto") { "⌫" } }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Scrollable
examples.notes: A long menu scrolls within the viewport.
examples.code:
phlex do
  DropdownMenu do
    DropdownMenuTrigger { |trigger| Button(**trigger, variant: :outline) { "Pick a timezone" } }
    DropdownMenuContent(class: "max-h-72") do
      DropdownMenuGroupLabel { "Timezones" }
      [ "Pacific/Honolulu", "America/Anchorage", "America/Los_Angeles", "America/Denver", "America/Chicago", "America/New_York", "America/Sao_Paulo",
        "Europe/London", "Europe/Paris", "Europe/Prague", "Europe/Athens", "Asia/Dubai", "Asia/Kolkata", "Asia/Singapore", "Asia/Tokyo", "Australia/Sydney" ].each do |zone|
        DropdownMenuItem { zone.tr("_", " ") }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Checkbox items
examples.notes: They keep the menu open; `checked-change` reports each toggle.

examples.name: Radio items
Submenus
examples.notes: Submenus open beside their trigger on hover, click or →.

examples.name: Open on hover
examples.code:
phlex do
  DropdownMenu(open_on_hover: true) do
    DropdownMenuTrigger { |trigger| Button(**trigger, variant: :ghost) { plain "Products"; Icon(:chevron_down, data: { icon: "end" }) } }
    DropdownMenuContent do
      %w[ Analytics Automation Integrations ].each { |label| DropdownMenuItem { label } }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Link items
examples.code:
phlex do
  DropdownMenu do
    DropdownMenuTrigger { |trigger| Button(**trigger, variant: :outline) { "Resources" } }
    DropdownMenuContent do
      DropdownMenuLinkItem(href: "#docs") { Icon(:file, data: { icon: "start" }); plain "Documentation" }
      DropdownMenuLinkItem(href: "https://appica.dev", target: "_blank", rel: "noopener") do
        Icon(:external_link, data: { icon: "start" })
        plain "Appica"
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Sizes
examples.notes: `size:` scales the rows, labels and popup radius.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-wrap gap-3") do
    %i[ sm md lg ].each do |size|
      DropdownMenu(size:) do
        DropdownMenuTrigger { |trigger| Button(**trigger, variant: :outline, size:) { size.to_s } }
        DropdownMenuContent { %w[ Edit Duplicate Archive ].each { |label| DropdownMenuItem { label } } }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Side & alignment
examples.notes: `side:` and `align:` place the popup; it flips when there's no room.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-wrap gap-3") do
    [ [ :bottom, :start ], [ :bottom, :end ], [ :top, :center ], [ :inline_end, :start ] ].each do |side, align|
      DropdownMenu do
        DropdownMenuTrigger { |trigger| Button(**trigger, variant: :outline, size: :sm) { "#{side} / #{align}" } }
        DropdownMenuContent(side:, align:) { %w[ Edit Duplicate Archive ].each { |label| DropdownMenuItem { label } } }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes: The popup aligns to the start edge and submenus open to the left.
